blocks.html: Your Favorite Artists Turn Up the Music at Robinsons Malls this Holiday Season Taking the stage at Robinsons Malls this Christmas are the country’s hottest artists, guaranteed to make every musical show an affair to remember indeed! Catch their awesome performances and be captivated by the voices of our very own Filipino talents! 1. ACOUSTIC HOLIDAY BEATS AT ROBINSONS MALLS Let the soulful voices of top acoustic artists Nyoy Volante, Luke Mejares, and Paolo Santos capture your hearts as they perform at Robinsons Malls this holiday season. NYOY VOLANTE Mr. Acoustic King himself, Nyoy Volante, tugs at your heartstrings with moving love ballads. He has also proven his mettle as a total performer, having won as first runner-up in Your Face Sounds Familiar Season 1, and as Aliw Awards 2016 Best Actor for Theater in his role in The Jersey Boys. ¬ LUKE MEJARES When you talk about Pinoy RnB, the name Luke Mejares quickly comes to your mind. His recent album entitled Blackbird is another testament to his artistic talent, as he gives his personal touch to Motown-inspired music. Get ready to groove with Luke as the multi-awarded RnB artist dazzles audiences with his signature vocal range. PAOLO SANTOS Paolo Santos first made waves in the acoustic scene in the early 2000s, when he successfully re-introduced the genre. It was a welcome respite at a time when consortium, house, and techno music were making waves. Acoustic music has since stayed on as a well-loved favorite among music lovers. Paolo’s guitar playing prowess and his impressive vocal sound combine perfectly to give audiences an unforgettable performance. Be there to watch the live performances of Luke Mijares and Paolo Santos on December 3 at Robinsons Place Ilocos and catch Nyoy Volante and Luke Mijares at Robinsons Place Antipolo on December 10, Robinsons Sta. Rosa on December 17 and Robinsons Place Malolos on December 22. Show starts at 5 pm. 2. THE VOICE TEENS TOP PERFORMERS MAKE JOYOUS MELODIES AT ROBINSONS MALLS Every reality singing contest fan’s dream just came true. The winner and top performer of The Voice Teens Philippines 2017 are sharing the stage at Robinsons Malls this Christmas for a remarkable music performance! JONA SOQUITE The Voice Teens Philippines Season 1 grand champion Jona Soquite brought coaches and audiences to their feet from the time she did her blind audition all the way to the finals! Victory did not come easy for the 13-year-old singer as it took her three auditions for The Voice Kids before finally getting the chance to perform onstage. Witness Jona’s live performances at Robinsons Malls this holiday season! ISABELA VINZON There’s no looking back for Isabela Vinzon after being named as one of the finalists of The Voice Teens Philippines Season 1. As part of Team Kawayan under Coach Bamboo, Isabela was among the major contenders for the title, with her strong stage presence and soulful, flexible jazz voice. Relive the impressive performance of this young and promising singer at Robinsons Malls this Christmas! JEREMY GLINOGA There was no way to go but up after Jeremy Glinoga emerged as one of the top performers in The Voice Teens Philippines Season 1. His memorable cover of Sign of the Times by Harry Styles was indeed stunning. Sample the soulful music of this 17-year-old balladeer when he takes the stage at Robinsons Malls this Christmas!FRANZ DACANAY Franz Dacanay took his talent to the stage and emerged as one of the top performers in The Voice Teens Philippines Season 1. Only 18 years old, Franz combines his passion for music with other interests like photography and cooking. He even runs his own business! Don’t miss his live musical performance at Robinsons Malls this Christmas! MIKE ESCUTIN Seventeen-year-old Mike Escutin made it to the Battle Rounds of The Voice Teens Philippines Season 1, and there has been no turning back since then. Under Team Sharon, he impressed audiences with his live performances, and eventually gained millions of views on his videos online. What else can Mike offer as an artist? Find out the answer when he takes the stage at Robinsons Malls to celebrate the yuletide season with fans and shoppers alike! Be there to watch the live performances of Jona Soquite, Isabela Vinzon, Jeremy Glinoga, Franz Dacanay, and Mike Escutin at Robinsons Place Las Piñas on December 3, Robinsons Place Dasmariñas on December 9, Robinsons Place Gen. Trias on December 10 and Robinsons Metro East on December 16. Show starts at 5 pm. 3. CELEBRATE THE PERFECT CHRISTMAS WITH DARREN ESPANTO Christmas is definitely in the air! And what better way to celebrate the perfect Christmas than to watch Darren Espanto in a live concert at Robinsons Malls? Witness how Darren showcases his exceptional stage presence and vocal power in every performance. After a runner-up finish at The Voice Kids, Darren has since become a sought after performer. Sing along with Darren on December 2 at Robinsons Place Pangasinan, December 3 at Robinsons Place Lipa, December 14 at Robinsons Place Santiago and December 17 at Forum Robinsons. Show starts at 5 pm. 4. MATTEO GUIDICELLI PERFORMS IN HOLIDAY MUSICAL SHOW AT ROBINSONS MALLS See the other side of Matteo Guidicelli as he performs in a series of musical shows at Robinsons Malls this December. Matteo is best known for his role in romantic movies and TV shows, but he is also a model, athlete, and music artist. His latest single entitled Hey signals his comeback to the music scene this year. Add Matteo’s musical shows at Robinsons Malls to your must-attend events this holiday season! Watch him perform at Robinsons Place Palawan on December 16, Robinsons Place Imus on December 17 and Robinsons Place Naga on December 21. Show starts at 5 pm.
